names.ja: カランコエ・ダイグレモンティアナ

light.best.quote: This plant prefers bright indirect sunlight or partial shade.

light.directSun.quote: It can tolerate some direct sunlight, but it is best to avoid the hot midday sun.

temperature.minC.reason: 霜に耐えず最低温度の記載がないため、カランコエの仲間の出典の値（45°F＝7℃）に合わせた

temperature.idealC.quote: It prefers temperatures between 65 and 75 degrees Fahrenheit

humidity.reason: 出典に湿度の記載はないが、葉や茎に水を蓄える乾燥に強い植物のため

watering.growing.quote: Allow the soil to dry out between waterings

watering.winter.quote: reduce watering during the plant's dormant stage

tips.ja: 葉のふちにできる子株が落ちて、どんどんふえる。
tips.quote: The plantlets themselves will develop roots and leaves, and they will drop off naturally from the parent plant.
